title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Document Forms (for Trial Implementation) of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Litigation
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Document Styles (for Trial Implementation) of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings

Fa Fa [2003] No. 2

High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

To promote the implementation of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court and to further standardize the trial activities of the people's courts, the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, at its 1258th meeting on November 25, 2002, discussed and adopted the Document Styles (for Trial Implementation) of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings. These are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation. Any problems encountered during implementation should be promptly reported to our Court.

January 9, 2003

Attached: Document Styles (for Trial Implementation) of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings

Style No. 1

XXX People's Court

Notice of Response to Action

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

This Court has accepted the case of XXX (name of plaintiff or appellant) v. you in a dispute over XX (cause of action). A copy of the complaint (or appeal) is hereby served, and the relevant matters are notified as follows:

1. During the proceedings, the parties have the right to exercise the litigation rights provided in Articles 50, 51, 52, etc. of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, and must simultaneously observe the litigation order and fulfill litigation obligations.

2. You shall submit a statement of defense in XX copies to this Court within fifteen days (thirty days for foreign-related cases) from the date of receipt of the complaint (or appeal).

3. If a legal person or other organization participates in the litigation, it shall submit the qualification certificate of the legal person or other organization and the certificate of identity of the legal representative or responsible person. If a natural person participates in the litigation, he or she shall submit an identity certificate.

4. If you need to appoint an agent to act on your behalf, you shall submit a power of attorney signed or sealed by the principal. The power of attorney shall specify the authorized matters and scope in accordance with Article 59 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

This notice is to be served on the defendant or the appellee.

Style No. 2

XXX People's Court

Notice of Burden of Proof

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

Pursuant to the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, the matters relating to the burden of proof are hereby notified as follows:

1. Each party shall bear the burden of proof for the facts on which its own claims are based or for the facts used to rebut the claims of the opposing party. If a party has no evidence or the evidence submitted is insufficient to prove its factual assertions, that party, which bears the burden of proof, shall bear the adverse consequences.

2. When providing evidence to the people's court, the original or physical object shall be provided, or a copy or replica verified by the court to be identical to the original. The evidence materials shall be numbered and categorized one by one, with a brief explanation of the source, the object of proof, and the content of the evidence materials, and copies shall be submitted according to the number of opposing parties.

3. Any application for appraisal, addition or change of claims, or filing of a counterclaim shall be made before the expiration of the time limit for submission of evidence.

4. If you apply for a witness to testify, you shall submit the application to this Court ten days[1] before the expiration of the time limit for submission of evidence.

5. An application for preservation of evidence shall be made seven days[2] before the expiration of the time limit for submission of evidence. This Court may, depending on the circumstances, require you to provide corresponding security.

6. After receiving this notice, you may negotiate with the opposing party to determine the time limit for submission of evidence, and then apply to this Court for approval. If you and the opposing party fail to reach an agreement, or do not apply for this Court's approval, or this Court does not approve, you shall submit evidence to this Court by XXXX, XX month, XX day.

7. If you have genuine difficulty in submitting evidence materials within the time limit for submission of evidence, you may apply to this Court for an extension of time in accordance with Article 36 of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court.

8. If the evidence submitted by you after the expiration of the time limit for submission of evidence does not meet the provisions on "new evidence" as specified in Article 41, Article 43, paragraph 2, and Article 44 of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, you shall be deemed to have waived the right to submit evidence, unless the opposing party agrees to examine it.

9. If your circumstances meet one of the conditions under Article 17 of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, you may apply in writing to this Court for investigation and collection of evidence seven days before the expiration of the time limit for submission of evidence.

Attachments:

1. If the circumstances under Article 4, Article 5, or Article 6 of the Several Provisions on Evidence (hereinafter referred to as the "Evidence Provisions") exist, the trial judge may fill in the details according to the specific circumstances of the case.

2. If a party may provide evidence formed outside the territory, the trial judge shall fill in the relevant content in accordance with Articles 11 and 12 of the Evidence Provisions.

3. ... (If the trial judge deems it necessary, he or she may specify that the party provide evidence relevant to the case according to the specific circumstances.)

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

This notice applies to first-instance proceedings.

When the people's court specifies the time limit for submission of evidence, it shall specify the date on which the time limit expires. If the time limit for submission of evidence for a party receiving the notice later is less than 30 days, the 31st day from the date of receipt of the notice shall be the date on which the time limit expires.

Notes:

[1] If summary procedure applies, the time limit for the party's application is not limited to ten days.

[2] If summary procedure applies, the time limit for the party's application is not limited to seven days.

Style No. 3

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Permitting Application for Extension of Time for Submission of Evidence)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), XXX (name of applicant) applied to this Court on XXXX, XX month, XX day for an extension of time for submission of evidence on the ground that ... (reason for extension of time for submission of evidence) and that it is genuinely difficult to submit evidence within the time limit.

Upon review, the application of XXX (name of applicant) meets the requirements of Article 36 of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, and this Court hereby grants it. The time limit for submission of evidence in this case is extended to XXXX, XX month, XX day.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 36 of the Evidence Provisions.

[2] The extension of the time limit for submission of evidence extends the time limit for both parties, not just one party. This notice shall be served on both parties.

Style No. 4

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Denying Application for Extension of Time for Submission of Evidence)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), XXX (name of applicant) applied to this Court on XXXX, XX month, XX day for an extension of time for submission of evidence on the ground that ... (reason for extension of time for submission of evidence) and that it is genuinely difficult to submit evidence within the time limit.

Upon review, the reasons given by XXX (name of applicant) for extending the time limit for submission of evidence are not established. Pursuant to Article 36 of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, this Court hereby denies the application.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 36 of the Evidence Provisions.

[2] This notice is served on the applicant. The content of this notice may be orally communicated to the applicant by the people's court, and noted in the record, signed by the party or agent.

Style No. 5

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Permitting/Denying Party's Application to Change Time for Submission of Evidence)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), this Court issued a notice of submission of evidence to you on XXXX, XX month, XX day, specifying that you shall submit evidence to this Court by XXXX, XX month, XX day. Now you and XXX (name of opposing party) have negotiated and agreed to complete the submission of evidence by XXXX, XX month, XX day, and have applied to this Court for approval.

Upon review, this Court hereby grants (or "denies") this application.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

The notice of permission shall be served on both parties. The notice of denial may be orally communicated to the applicant by the people's court, and noted in the record, signed by the party or agent.

Style No. 6

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Change of Time for Submission of Evidence Due to Service by Publication)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), because ... (fill in according to the specific circumstances of the case involving "the person to be served cannot be located, or cannot be served by other means"), this Court is now serving the relevant litigation documents by publication. The deadline for submission of evidence in this case is changed to XXXX, XX month, XX day. If evidence is submitted after that date, the right to submit evidence shall be deemed waived.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] The changed deadline for submission of evidence shall be no less than 30 days from the expiration of the publication period.

[2] This notice is served on the parties other than the person to be served by publication.

Style No. 7

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Change of Time for Submission of Evidence Due to Addition of Party or Intervention of Third Party with Independent Claims)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), because ... (fill in according to the specific circumstances of the case involving "addition of a party" or "XXX intervenes as a third party with independent claims", and specify the name and litigation status of the added party), this Court decides that the deadline for submission of evidence in this case is changed to XXXX, XX month, XX day. If evidence is submitted after that date, the right to submit evidence shall be deemed waived.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

This notice is served on all parties other than the added party.

Style No. 8

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Specified Time for Submission of Evidence on Appeal)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

This Court has accepted the appeal in the case of you v. XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action). Pursuant to the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, if you have new evidence, you may negotiate with the opposing party to determine the time limit for submission of evidence and then apply to this Court for approval; if no agreement is reached, or no application for approval is made to this Court, or this Court does not approve, you shall submit the relevant evidence by XXXX, XX month, XX day. If evidence is submitted after that date, the right to submit evidence shall be deemed waived.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] This notice applies to the circumstance of a specified time limit for submission of evidence on appeal.

[2] The time limit for submission of evidence on appeal specified by the people's court is not subject to the "no less than thirty days" restriction under Article 33, paragraph 3 of the Evidence Provisions, and the people's court may specify the time limit based on the circumstances of the case.

[3] This notice is served on both parties.

Style No. 9

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Respecified Time for Submission of Evidence)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), XXX (name of party changing the claim or filing a counterclaim) has ... before the expiration of the time limit for submission of evidence (fill in according to the specific circumstances of the party changing the claim or filing a counterclaim. If Article 35 of the Evidence Provisions applies, it shall be stated as "XXX has changed the claim after being informed by this Court").

You shall submit evidence to this Court by XXXX, XX month, XX day. Failure to do so will be deemed a waiver of the right to submit evidence.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 34, paragraph 3 and Article 35 of the Evidence Provisions.

[2] This notice is served on both parties.

Style No. 10

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Exchange of Evidence Organized by the Court upon Party Application)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), upon application by XXX (name of applicant), this Court, pursuant to Article 37 of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, decides to organize the parties to exchange evidence at XX hour, XX minute on XXXX, XX month, XX day. You shall attend on time at XXX (location of evidence exchange). The date of evidence exchange shall be the deadline for submission of evidence; if evidence is submitted after that date, the right to submit evidence shall be deemed waived.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 37, paragraph 1 of the Evidence Provisions.

[2] This notice is served on both parties.

Style No. 11

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Exchange of Evidence Organized by the Court Ex Officio)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), because ... (filled in by the trial judge based on the specific circumstances of the case where evidence is voluminous or complex and difficult), this Court, pursuant to Article 37 (or Article 40 if it is a re-exchange of evidence) of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, decides to organize the parties to exchange evidence at XX hour, XX minute on XXXX, XX month, XX day. You shall attend on time at XXX (location of evidence exchange). The date of evidence exchange shall be the deadline for submission of evidence; if evidence is submitted after that date, the right to submit evidence shall be deemed waived.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 37, paragraph 2 and Article 40 of the Evidence Provisions.

[2] This notice is served on both parties.

Style No. 12

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Denying Application for Exchange of Evidence)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), you applied to this Court on XXXX, XX month, XX day for pre-trial exchange of evidence.

Upon review, this Court considers that ... (state reasons for denial). Your application is hereby denied.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] This notice applies to the circumstances under Article 37, paragraph 1 of the Evidence Provisions.

[2] This notice is served on the applicant. The content of this notice may be orally communicated to the party by the trial judge, and noted in the record, signed by the party or agent.

Style No. 13

XXX People's Court

Notice

(Permitting Party's Application for Court Investigation and Collection of Evidence)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), XXX (name of applicant) applied to this Court on XXXX, XX month, XX day for investigation and collection of ... (name of evidence the party applied for the court to investigate and collect).

Upon review, your application meets the relevant provisions of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, and this Court hereby grants it.

XXXX, XX month, XX day

(Court Seal)

Note:

[1] This notice is served on the applicant.

[2] The content of this notice may be orally communicated to the party by the people's court, and noted in the record, signed or sealed by the applicant.

Style No. 14

XXX People's Court

Decision

(Denying Party's Application for Court Investigation and Collection of Evidence)

(XXXX) XXX Zi No. XXX

To XXX:

In the case of a dispute between you and XXX (name of opposing party and cause of action), you applied to this Court on XXXX, XX month, XX day for investigation and collection of ... (name of evidence the party applied for the court to investigate and collect).

Upon review, this Court considers that ... (reasons for the people's court's denial of the party's application for investigation and collection of evidence). Your application does not meet the requirements of Article 17 (or Article 18 or Article 19, as applicable) of the Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings of the Supreme People's Court, and this Court hereby denies it.

If you are dissatisfied with this decision, you may apply in writing to this Court for review once within three days from the day following receipt of this decision.

______, ______ (date)

(Official Seal)

Note: This decision is served upon the applicant.

Form 15

______ People's Court

Ruling on Reconsideration

(Rejecting an Application for Reconsideration of a Decision Denying a Motion for Investigation and Collection of Evidence)

(______) ______ No. ______

To ______:

You, not satisfied with the Decision on Denying Your Motion for Investigation and Collection of Evidence (______) ______ No. ______ of this Court, filed an application for reconsideration with this Court on ______, ______ (date), submitting: ______ (the applicant's request and reasons for reconsideration).

Upon examination, this Court finds that: ______ (the reasons for this Court's ruling on reconsideration). Pursuant to Article 19 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, it is hereby ruled as follows:

The application is rejected, and the original decision is affirmed.

______, ______ (date)

(Official Seal)

Note: This ruling is served upon the applicant.

Form 16

______ People's Court

Ruling on Reconsideration

(Reversing the Original Decision)

(______) ______ No. ______

2. The application of ______ (the name of the party who applied to the People's Court for investigation and collection of evidence) submitted to this Court on ______, ______ (date) for investigation and collection of evidence ______ (the name of the evidence for which the party applied to the People's Court for investigation and collection) is granted.

______, ______ (date)

(Official Seal)

Note: This ruling is served upon the applicant.

Pursuant to paragraph 2 of Article 23 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, you shall provide ______ (the specific method of security; the People's Court may specify the form of security according to the specific circumstances of the case) as security within ______ days of receipt of this notice. Failure to provide security within the time limit shall be deemed a waiver of the application.

Notice

(Rejecting an Application for Preservation of Evidence)

(______) ______ No. ______

To ______:

In connection with the case of your dispute with ______ (the name of the opposing party and the cause of action), you filed an application for preservation of evidence with this Court on ______, ______ (date), requesting ______ (the evidence to be preserved and the method of preservation; if the party provided security, it shall also be stated).

Upon examination, this Court finds that: ______ (the reasons for the decision). Pursuant to Article 74 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 23 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings (if there are other laws or judicial interpretations that apply, they may be cited), this Court hereby decides to reject your application for preservation of evidence.

______, ______ (date)

(Official Seal)

Note: This notice is served upon the applicant. The contents of the notice may be orally communicated to the party and recorded in the record, with the party or agent signing.

Form 20

______ People's Court

Notice

(Granting an Application for Re-Appraisal)

(______) ______ No. ______

To ______:

In connection with the case of ______ 's (the name of the party applying for re-appraisal) dispute with ______ (the name of the opposing party and the cause of action), ______ has objections to the appraisal conclusion made by ______ (the name of the appraisal institution or the appraiser) entrusted by ______ Court, arguing that ______ (the party's reasons for applying for re-appraisal), and filed an application for re-appraisal with this Court on ______, ______ (date).

Upon examination, the application of ______ (the name of the applicant) meets the requirements of Article 27 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, and this Court hereby grants it.

______, ______ (date)

(Official Seal)

Form 22

______ People's Court

Notice

(Granting a Party's Application for a Witness to Testify in Court)

(______) ______ No. ______

To ______:

In connection with the case of your dispute with ______ (the name of the opposing party and the cause of action), you filed an application with this Court on ______, ______ (date) for the witness ______ (the name of the witness) to testify in court on matters concerning ______ (the matters on which the witness is to testify).

Upon examination, your application meets the requirements of Article 54 of the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, and this Court hereby grants it.

______, ______ (date)

(Official Seal)

Note:
1. This notice applies to the circumstances specified in Article 54 of the Provisions on Evidence.
2. This notice is served upon the applying party, but the application for the witness to testify in court shall be recorded in the evidence list or evidence receipt.

Form 23

(Rejecting a Party's Application for a Witness to Testify in Court)

To ______:

Upon examination, ______ (the reasons for rejecting the party's application), this Court does not grant it.

______, ______ (date)

(Official Seal)

Note:
1. This notice applies to the circumstances specified in Article 54 of the Provisions on Evidence.
2. This notice is served upon the applicant. The contents of the notice may be orally communicated to the applicant by the trial judge and recorded in the record, with the party or agent signing.

Form 24

______ People's Court

Notice

(Notifying a Witness to Testify in Court Upon a Party's Application)

(______) ______ No. ______

To ______:

In connection with the case of ______ v. ______ (the names of the parties and the cause of action), ______ (the name of the party who applied for the witness to testify in court) has filed an application with this Court for you (if the witness is an entity, "your entity" may be used) to testify in court, and this Court has granted the application. You (if the witness is an entity, "your entity" may be used) shall appear at ______ (the location where the witness is to testify) at ______ o'clock on ______, ______ (date) with valid identification to attend the court hearing (if the witness testifies at evidence exchange, it may be stated as "evidence exchange") and give testimony. Pursuant to the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China and the Supreme People's Court's Several Provisions on Evidence in Civil Proceedings, you are hereby notified of the following:

1. Any unit or individual that has knowledge of the circumstances of the case has the obligation to testify in court.

2. A witness shall objectively testify to facts personally perceived and shall not use speculative, inferential, or evaluative language. A witness shall not read a pre-prepared written testimony.

3. A witness shall testify truthfully and truthfully answer questions posed by the trial judge and the parties. A witness who gives false testimony shall bear corresponding legal liability.

4. A witness shall not sit in on the court hearing and shall not exchange views with the parties or other witnesses.

5. The lawful rights of a witness are protected by law.

______, ______ (date)

(Official Seal)

Note:
1. This notice applies to the circumstances specified in Article 54 of the Provisions on Evidence.
2. This notice is served upon the witness.

Form 26

______ People's Court
